mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as elevated interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce the present value of future equity cash flows.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.0%.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) rises above 3.5% in the past month, it signals a tightening monetary policy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as markets react to the immediate policy shift.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals a monetary tightening cycle that is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as the dual pressures of higher interest rates and weak labor market reduce corporate earnings growth prospects.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS change > 0.1% and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: In high-inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually), the S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days are negative due to central bank tightening and reduced consumer spending, as measured by the CPIAUCSL series.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annually.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 2000 thousand units signals weak consumer demand and reduced economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST < 2000.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 120.0 (index 2017=100) signals a weakening economy and reduced corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 120.0.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals a deteriorating labor market, which is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate profit concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of instances where UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A lower level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) is associated with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as weak housing market activity reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances where RSAFS < 350,000.
